assets.name: 浅木静居
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean photoreal architectural room background for a live 3D furniture compositor.
Input Image 1 is the ONLY edit target and the absolute authority for composition, geometry and every object's position. Other input images are MATERIAL/STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; ignore their camera, room layouts, furniture, people, black bars, phone UI and text.
Output: one sharp 1536 x 1024 image or higher resolution with EXACTLY the same 3:2 aspect ratio as Image 1. Photoreal architectural photography with physically credible fine wood/stone texture, clean edges and clear material detail, never illustration.
CRITICAL LOCKED INVARIANTS: retain Image 1's exact camera position, lens, framing, vanishing point, perspective, image-space object footprints, wall proportions, room depth and width, wall/door/opening positions, left glass partition, all ceiling planes, soffits and ceiling height. Do not expand or redesign the room. Keep the left TV's exact footprint and black screen; the left console's exact bounds; the background dining table and every chair's exact position, dimensions and silhouette; the tall back-left bookcase and the back cabinet's exact silhouette and bounds; every ceiling and pendant light's exact geometry and position. Keep all small existing furniture-top objects in their current positions and silhouettes.
The ENTIRE cleared foreground floor and right sofa area must remain completely empty for later 3D furniture insertion: NO sofa, coffee table, armchair, ottoman, rug, new lamp, new plant, new decor, or any added object there. No new furniture anywhere.
Replace the images within the existing wall artwork footprints with restrained black-and-white fine-art photography, keeping each artwork's frame footprint, dimensions and placement exact. No new artwork elsewhere.
Avoid orange color grading, intensely orange cove lighting, glossy hotel marble, ornate trim, exaggerated luxury, darkness that hides texture, CGI/plastic sheen, blur, text, watermark, screenshots or interface elements.
Change only the finish/material/lighting style described below; preserve source geometry throughout.
STYLE A — 浅木静居, inspired by the quiet pale-oak guest rooms of Shanghai EDITION.
Apply pale natural oak wall panelling with subtle straight vertical grain to the right wall and back wall, and harmonious pale oak to the remaining wall panels while retaining all source openings and planes. Elegant broad flat panels, quiet thin joints, matte natural finish; light beige oak rather than yellow-orange. Preserve the existing ceiling geometry in understated warm white. Refinish the existing foreground floor as pale oak planks following its exact perspective. Refinish the existing table, chair frames, console, bookcase and back cabinet in pale oak while preserving their exact shapes, silhouettes and positions; chair upholstery becomes soft taupe. Keep the existing fixture geometry and refine visible metal finish gently. Natural daytime illumination and restrained soft warm cove illumination in the existing ceiling recesses. Luminous but believable, enough directional daylight to show real grain and depth. Monochrome photography only inside the existing art footprints. Image 2 and Image 3 are inspiration for oak grain, panel restraint and monochrome art only; do not import their furnishings or geometry.
